claims: The 130th Boston Marathon will take place on Monday, April 20, 2026.
The 130th Boston Marathon will take place on Patriots' Day.
The 130th Boston Marathon runs from Hopkinton to Copley Square, Boston.
The 130th Boston Marathon is an Abbott World Marathon Major.
The 130th Boston Marathon required a 4-minute, 34-second cut-off time (4:34) for qualifiers.
The 130th Boston Marathon is organized by the Boston Athletic Association (B.A.A.).
24,362 qualifiers were accepted for the 130th Boston Marathon.
The qualifying cut-off for the 130th Boston Marathon was 4:34 faster than the standard.
33,249 applications were received for the 130th Boston Marathon.
Wheelchair divisions start at 9:02 a.m. (men) in the 130th Boston Marathon.
Wheelchair divisions start at 9:05 a.m. (women) in the 130th Boston Marathon.
Professional runners start at 9:37 a.m. in the 130th Boston Marathon.
Professional runners start at 9:45 a.m. in the 130th Boston Marathon.
The B.A.A. Expo is at the Hynes Convention Center.
